The '''Dongju River''' is a major waterway in [[Erythrea]] associated with the [[Democratic Republic of Suzuharu]].

The Erythrea source describes the river as a defining feature of Suzuharu's topography, supporting agriculture, trade, fresh water access, fertile floodplains, and settlement along its banks.

== Source Limits ==

The current source does not provide the river's source, mouth, length, tributaries, exact course, or political border role. This draft therefore treats Dongju as a geographic anchor rather than a complete river article.
